dilate: The doctor used special drops to dilate her eyes before checking them.
医生用特殊的药水为她散瞳后再进行检查。
impel: Hunger impelled the travelers to keep walking until they found a village.
饥饿驱使旅行者们继续前行,直到找到一个村庄。
lichen: Lichen grows slowly on old rocks and tree bark in the forest.
地衣在森林里的老岩石和树皮上生长得很慢。
photodissociation: Photodissociation breaks molecules apart when they absorb light energy from the sun.
光解作用是指分子吸收太阳光的能量后分解开来。
sumptuous: The hotel served a sumptuous breakfast with fresh fruit and warm bread.
这家酒店供应丰盛的早餐,有新鲜水果和热面包。
arduous: Climbing the mountain in heavy rain was an arduous task for everyone.
在大雨中爬山对每个人来说都是一项艰巨的任务。
charisma: Her natural charisma makes people trust her and follow her advice.
她天生的魅力使人们信任她并听从她的建议。
supplier: Our main supplier failed to deliver the materials on time last month.
上个月我们的主要供应商未能按时交付材料。
patriarchic: In that patriarchic family, the eldest son always makes the final decisions.
在那个父权制家庭里,总是由长子做最终的决定。
digression: The teacher's digression into old stories made the lecture more interesting.
老师讲起往事的题外话,使讲座变得更有趣。
incursion: The sudden incursion of enemy troops surprised the small border village.
敌军的突然入侵使这个边境小村庄大为震惊。
airborne: The virus can remain airborne for several hours in closed rooms.
这种病毒能在密闭的房间里在空气中悬浮数小时。
poetic: She described the sunset in poetic language that moved everyone present.
她用诗意的语言描述日落,打动了在场的每一个人。
apportionment: The apportionment of the costs among the three families caused an argument.
三个家庭之间分摊费用的问题引发了一场争论。
tyrannical: The tyrannical king punished anyone who disagreed with his unfair laws.
那位残暴的国王惩罚任何不赞同他不公正法律的人。
opal: Her mother gave her a beautiful opal ring for her birthday.
她母亲送给她一枚漂亮的蛋白石戒指作为生日礼物。
rayon: This summer dress is made of rayon, so it feels soft and cool.
这条夏裙是人造丝做的,所以摸起来柔软凉爽。
scornful: He gave a scornful laugh when I suggested such a simple method.
当我提出这么简单的方法时,他轻蔑地笑了一下。
balm: Her kind words were a balm to my tired heart.
她温暖的话语抚慰了我疲惫的心。
externality: Pollution from the factory is a negative externality that harms nearby residents.
工厂的污染是一种损害附近居民的负外部性。
aberrant: The scientist noticed aberrant behavior in the mice after the experiment.
科学家注意到实验后小鼠的行为出现了异常。
courier: A courier delivered the important documents to our office this morning.
今天早上一名信使把重要文件送到了我们办公室。
confederacy: The two tribes formed a confederacy to defend their shared lands.
这两个部落结成联盟来保卫他们共同的土地。
devout: Her grandmother is a devout believer who prays every morning.
她的祖母是一位虔诚的信徒,每天早晨都要祈祷。
conductivity: Copper is widely used in wires because of its high conductivity.
铜因其高导电性而被广泛用于制作电线。
cortex: The cortex of the brain controls memory, language, and thinking.
大脑皮层控制着记忆、语言和思维。
forerunner: This old machine was a forerunner of today's modern computers.
这台老式机器是现代计算机的先驱。
insolvent: The company became insolvent after losing its biggest customer.
失去最大的客户后,这家公司就破产了。
paucity: The report failed because of a paucity of reliable data.
由于可靠数据的匮乏,这份报告没有成功。
packed: The train was so packed that we had to stand all the way.
火车非常拥挤,我们只好一路站着。
diminution: There has been a steady diminution in the number of wild birds here.
这里野生鸟类的数量一直在稳步减少。
wintry: A wintry wind blew through the streets as we walked home.
我们步行回家时,寒冷的冬风吹过街道。
cascara: The pharmacist recommended cascara as a mild medicine for digestion problems.
药剂师推荐用缓泻剂作为治疗消化问题的温和药物。
bluster: The wind continued to bluster all night, shaking the windows loudly.
风整夜呼啸,把窗户吹得哗哗作响。
inactivate: Heating can inactivate the harmful substances in some wild plants.
加热可以使某些野生植物中的有害物质失去活性。
plaudit: The young pianist earned the plaudits of both critics and audiences.
这位年轻的钢琴家赢得了评论家和观众的一致好评。
exalt: The poem exalts the beauty of nature and simple country life.
这首诗颂扬了大自然之美和简朴的乡村生活。
grump: Dad is such a grump before he has his morning coffee.
爸爸早上喝咖啡之前脾气可真不好。
grovel: He had to grovel and apologize before she agreed to help him.
在她答应帮忙之前,他不得不低声下气地道歉。
confidant: Over the years, my sister has become my closest confidant.
这些年来,我妹妹成了我最亲密的知己。
